For the fiscal years 2016 through 2018, Nike's cost of goods sold (cost of sales) as a percentage of revenue was:
- FY2016: 53.8% (Cost of sales of $17,405 million divided by Revenues of $32,376 million)
- FY2017: 55.4% (Cost of sales of $19,038 million divided by Revenues of $34,350 million)
- FY2018: 56.2% (Cost of sales of $20,441 million divided by Revenues of $36,397 million)

The three-year average of cost of goods sold as a percentage of revenue is 55.1%.
rationale: Extracted cost of sales and revenues from Nike's Consolidated Statements of Income for FY2016, FY2017, and FY2018. Calculated the percentage for each year and then computed the three-year average, rounding to one decimal place.
